name: P14 销售订单与订单行

sources.sql:
SELECT r.*,g.migrationVersion,CASE WHEN g.payloadVariants>1 THEN 'DUPLICATE_BUSINESS_KEY_CONFLICT' ELSE NULL END AS migrationIssue
FROM pm_order_data_from_erp r
JOIN (SELECT source,compCode,orderType,orderNumber,MAX(syncTime) AS migrationVersion,COUNT(DISTINCT JSON_ARRAY(orderCreateTime,customerRequireTime,customerCode,customerName,projectName,orderComment,salesType,customInfo,contractNo,orderExecNumber)) AS payloadVariants
FROM pm_order_data_from_erp GROUP BY source,compCode,orderType,orderNumber) g ON r.source <=> g.source AND r.compCode <=> g.compCode AND r.orderType <=> g.orderType AND r.orderNumber <=> g.orderNumber
JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT pc.contractNo
FROM pm_project_group_relationship m
JOIN pm_project_group g ON g.projectGroupCode=m.projectGroupCode
  AND CAST(g.projectGroupCode AS BINARY)=CAST(m.projectGroupCode AS BINARY)
JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT scoped.projectId,scoped.projectCode,scoped.projectType
FROM (SELECT original.*,canonical.projectId AS canonicalProjectId
FROM pm_project original
JOIN (
  SELECT CAST(projectType AS BINARY) AS typeKey,CAST(projectCode AS BINARY) AS codeKey,
    MAX(projectId) AS projectId
  FROM pm_project
  GROUP BY CAST(projectType AS BINARY),CAST(projectCode AS BINARY)
) canonical ON canonical.typeKey <=> CAST(original.projectType AS BINARY)
  AND canonical.codeKey <=> CAST(original.projectCode AS BINARY)
JOIN pm_project current_project ON current_project.projectId=canonical.projectId
WHERE current_project.disabled=0 AND current_project.effectiveTo IS NULL
  AND original.disabled=0 AND original.effectiveTo IS NULL
  AND FIND_IN_SET(current_project.projectType,:projectTypes)
  AND (:projectIds='' OR FIND_IN_SET(canonical.projectId,:projectIds))) scoped
WHERE scoped.projectId=scoped.canonicalProjectId) p
  ON p.projectCode=REPLACE(m.projectCode,'-his','') AND p.projectType=g.projectType
  AND CAST(p.projectCode AS BINARY)=CAST(REPLACE(m.projectCode,'-his','') AS BINARY)
  AND CAST(p.projectType AS BINARY)=CAST(g.projectType AS BINARY)
JOIN pm_project_contract pc ON pc.projectGroupCode=g.projectGroupCode
  AND CAST(pc.projectGroupCode AS BINARY)=CAST(g.projectGroupCode AS BINARY)) scope ON scope.contractNo=r.contractNo

SELECT scoped.* FROM (
SELECT r.*,g.migrationVersion,CASE WHEN g.payloadVariants>1 THEN 'DUPLICATE_BUSINESS_KEY_CONFLICT' ELSE NULL END AS migrationIssue ,EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM pm_order_data_from_erp h WHERE h.source=r.source AND h.compCode=r.compCode
 AND h.orderType=r.lineType AND h.orderNumber=r.orderNumber GROUP BY h.source,h.compCode,h.orderType,h.orderNumber
 HAVING MAX(h.syncTime) IS NOT NULL AND COUNT(DISTINCT JSON_ARRAY(h.orderCreateTime,h.customerRequireTime,h.customerCode,
 h.customerName,h.projectName,h.orderComment,h.salesType,h.customInfo,h.contractNo,h.orderExecNumber))=1) AS migrationParentExists
FROM pm_order_line_from_erp r
JOIN (SELECT source,compCode,lineType,orderNumber,lineNum,MAX(syncTime) AS migrationVersion,COUNT(DISTINCT JSON_ARRAY(itemCode,itemDesc,orderQuantity,openQuantity,bundleCode,warrantyMonth,profitCenter,realOrderExecNumber,customInfo)) AS payloadVariants
FROM pm_order_line_from_erp GROUP BY source,compCode,lineType,orderNumber,lineNum) g ON r.source <=> g.source AND r.compCode <=> g.compCode AND r.lineType <=> g.lineType AND r.orderNumber <=> g.orderNumber AND r.lineNum <=> g.lineNum
WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM pm_order_data_from_erp parent
 JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT pc.contractNo
FROM pm_project_group_relationship m
JOIN pm_project_group g ON g.projectGroupCode=m.projectGroupCode
  AND CAST(g.projectGroupCode AS BINARY)=CAST(m.projectGroupCode AS BINARY)
JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT scoped.projectId,scoped.projectCode,scoped.projectType
FROM (SELECT original.*,canonical.projectId AS canonicalProjectId
FROM pm_project original
JOIN (
  SELECT CAST(projectType AS BINARY) AS typeKey,CAST(projectCode AS BINARY) AS codeKey,
    MAX(projectId) AS projectId
  FROM pm_project
  GROUP BY CAST(projectType AS BINARY),CAST(projectCode AS BINARY)
) canonical ON canonical.typeKey <=> CAST(original.projectType AS BINARY)
  AND canonical.codeKey <=> CAST(original.projectCode AS BINARY)
JOIN pm_project current_project ON current_project.projectId=canonical.projectId
WHERE current_project.disabled=0 AND current_project.effectiveTo IS NULL
  AND original.disabled=0 AND original.effectiveTo IS NULL
  AND FIND_IN_SET(current_project.projectType,:projectTypes)
  AND (:projectIds='' OR FIND_IN_SET(canonical.projectId,:projectIds))) scoped
WHERE scoped.projectId=scoped.canonicalProjectId) p
  ON p.projectCode=REPLACE(m.projectCode,'-his','') AND p.projectType=g.projectType
  AND CAST(p.projectCode AS BINARY)=CAST(REPLACE(m.projectCode,'-his','') AS BINARY)
  AND CAST(p.projectType AS BINARY)=CAST(g.projectType AS BINARY)
JOIN pm_project_contract pc ON pc.projectGroupCode=g.projectGroupCode
  AND CAST(pc.projectGroupCode AS BINARY)=CAST(g.projectGroupCode AS BINARY)) scope ON scope.contractNo=parent.contractNo
 WHERE parent.source <=> r.source AND parent.compCode <=> r.compCode AND parent.orderType <=> r.lineType AND parent.orderNumber <=> r.orderNumber)
) scoped WHERE (:sourceIds='' OR FIND_IN_SET(scoped.id,:sourceIds))
